content:
Lina Gomez: Heads-up — noticed ~120 leads in 'unassigned' over the last 24h. Suspect enrichment TTL race with HubSpot assignment rule. Anyone else seeing this?
Samir Rao: Yup, saw spikes around 03:00–04:00 UTC. Our enrichment job lagged ~7–12m. HubSpot RR assignment currently waits for property `company_enriched = true`, so leads just sit orphaned.
Alex Chen: Can we do a heartbeat/fallback? Proposal: if enrichment > 10m, auto-assign to fallback pool 'Inbound Overflow' and ping SDRs. :thinking:
Maya Patel: I like the timebox. Important: SFDC mapping needs to be idempotent — if we assign early, enrichment should be able to patch without clobbering rep ownership. Add a `claimed_by` lock field and `auto_claim_reason`.
Lina Gomez: Proposed concrete workflow: 10-minute timebox + HubSpot workflow to set owner to 'Inbound Overflow' after 10m and add a note 'auto-claim: enrichment delayed'. I'll draft it.
Samir Rao: Can you paste the HS workflow snippet when you have it? Also we need the RR logic to skip leads with an `auto_claim_reason` flag so we don't double-rotate.
Lina Gomez: Workflow (HubSpot) draft:
- Trigger: Contact created
- Condition: property `company_enriched` is false AND `created_at` <= now - 10 minutes
- Action: Set owner = user(12345) 'Inbound Overflow'
- Action: Add note: "auto-claimed due to enrichment delay"
- Action: set property `auto_claim_reason` = "enrichment_timeout_v1"
Alex Chen: Add a queryable tag is great — RevOps should be able to surface `auto_claim_reason=enrichment_timeout_v1`. For routing fix: change round-robin to ignore contacts where `auto_claim_reason` exists. We'll push a patch to the routing service to respect that.
revops-bot: deploy-bot: CI pipeline queued for branch `routing/fallback-enrichment-timebox`. ETA ~30m. :robot_face:
Maya Patel: On SFDC side I'll map the 'Inbound Overflow' owner to an SF Queue (Inbound Overflow) and add a daily alert if orphan count > 50. Also will ensure reconciliation rule: enrichment_owner should overwrite only if it contains a valid rep id.
Samir Rao: One question — risk of duplicate claims when enrichment completes minutes later? Need a reconciliation policy: if enrichment fills `owner_rep` and it's different from 'Inbound Overflow', should enrichment override? Or should we keep the auto-claim and create a task to reassign?
Alex Chen: Agreement: enrichment-assigned owner wins when it contains a valid rep id. Reconciliation job: run every 15m, for contacts with `auto_claim_reason`, if `enrichment_owner` present and != auto owner -> set owner = enrichment_owner, clear `auto_claim_reason`, add note 'reassigned by enrichment'. If enrichment_owner is null, keep auto owner.
Lina Gomez: Timeline: I'll create the HubSpot workflow & doc in the playbook today (https://docs.redwood.com/playbooks/inbound-handoff). Samir/Alex to patch RR service and routing. Maya to update SF mapping and alert. RevOps to watch CI and deploy. Quick check-in tomorrow 10:00am PT?
revops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "lead-handoff-sync" tomorrow 10:00am PT.
Samir Rao: :+1: Thanks team.
